account_code_purchase.description: The code used to attribute the purchase of the product to a specific account for the Xero integration.

account_code_sale.description: The code used to attribute the sales of the product to a specific account for the Xero integration.

all_outlets_tax.description: Only used for tax inclusive stores.

tax_id.description: The tax id associated with this product.

description.description: A detailed description of the Product. **Note** Can contain HTML.

dimensions_unit.description: Unit of measurement for product dimensions. These are used to calculate variable shipping rates for stores using Lightspeed eCom.

height.description: Product height. These are used to calculate variable shipping rates for stores using Lightspeed eCom.

is_active.description: Indicated whether the Product is active.

length.description: Product length. These are used to calculate variable shipping rates for stores using Lightspeed eCom.

loyalty_amount.description: The amount of loyalty the customer receives buying this item.

name.description: Product name. **Note:** Variants share the same name.

outlet_taxes.description: Only used for tax exclusive stores.

price_excluding_tax.description: The price before tax is added.

price_including_tax.description: The price including all the relevant taxes.

product_type_id.description: The product category. **Note** Product types are now product categories.

source.description: Indicates the origin of the product. Can be USER, SHOPIFY.

tag_ids.description: An array of tag IDs associated with this product.

weight.description: Product weight. These are used to calculate variable shipping rates for stores using Lightspeed eCom.

weight_unit.description: Unit of measurement for product weight. These are used to calculate variable shipping rates for stores using Lightspeed eCom.

width.description: Product width. These are used to calculate variable shipping rates for stores using Lightspeed eCom.

product_id.description: The ID of the component product.

quantity.description: The quantity of the component product.

index.description: The position of the image in the list of images.

location.description: The location of the given file. Depending on the image provider type. s3 - The s3 key for s3 transfers. url - A full URL for url based images. product-image - the image id from an existing product image. sku-image - the image id from an existing variant image.

current_amount.description: Current inventory at a given outlet.

outlet_id.description: The outlet the inventory is for.

reorder_amount.description: The default of the quantity for auto-filled inventory orders.

reorder_point.description: Quantity below which the product should be included in the auto-filled inventory orders. use -1 to clear the reorder point.

outlet_id.description: The outlet the tax is for.

tax_id.description: The tax id associated with this outlet.

all_outlets_tax.description: Only used for tax inclusive stores.

tax_id.description: The tax id associated with this product.

length.description: Product length. These are used to calculate variable shipping rates for stores using Lightspeed eCom.

price_including_tax.description: The price including all the relevant taxes.

sku.description: Product sku. This value should be included in the `product_codes` array. If it's not, it will be added automatically.

variant_definitions.description: The attributes associated with this variant. e.g. Size.

width.description: Product width. These are used to calculate variable shipping rates for stores using Lightspeed eCom.

type.description: The type of code being added.

code.description: The code associated with this supplier.

price.description: The price associated with this supplier.

attribute_id.description: The ID of the variant attribute.

value.description: The value associated with the given attribute_id. e.g. Green.
